title: Minoes, Minnie, Minu en andere katse streken. De internationale receptie van Annie M.G. Schmidts Minoes
bookshelves: Category: Biography, Literature and Literary studies
summary: This volume focuses on the international reception of Annie M.G. Schmidt’s Minoes, the most translated Dutch children’s book. The authors investigate the reception and adaptations in the Netherlands and Flanders, the French translation and Canadian retranslation, the Hungarian translation and theatrical adaptation, and the Swedish, Russian, Polish and African reception.
